leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a modal component with open/close state management
Implement event listeners for keyboard interactions
Configure backdrop click functionality to close the modal
Bind escape key press to trigger modal closure
Integrate modal visibility control with user interface elements
Manipulate DOM elements to display and hide modal content
Initialize modal state and event handlers on component mount
lessonTitle: Build a modal with escape and backdrop close
